' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^probe_complete=true$'; then break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; echo '--- runtime provider physical report ---'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT"; echo '--- end runtime provider physical report ---'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^backend_config_valid=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^stt_transcript_nonblank=true$'; printf '%s
